# One Day

> A calm to-do list that shows one day at a time. It runs in the browser, with no account, no server and no tracking: tasks stay in the browser's storage, on the user's device, and, if the user turns sync on, in their own Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive, encrypted with a passphrase before they leave.

One Day is free and open source (MIT). It works offline once it has been opened, and it can be installed as an app.

Things people often need to know:

- There is no account. Each browser keeps its own list unless sync is on: Sync with your cloud (the cloud beside the lock, or More on a phone) keeps one list through the user's own Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive, with the same account and the same sync passphrase on each device. Without sync, tasks move to another device as a link (Send, or Send this day) or as a backup file (Export backup, then Import backup, which only adds what is missing).
- The lock is optional. A forgotten passphrase cannot be recovered by anyone; the only way out erases the tasks.
- A forgotten sync passphrase cannot be recovered either: Forgot it?, where One Day asks for it, erases the copy in the cloud and starts again from that device.
- Safari can erase a website's data after seven days without a visit, unless One Day is installed (Add to Home Screen, or Add to Dock on a Mac).
- An installed copy showing an old version updates after it is closed and opened again, twice.
- An assistant adds tasks by writing a link, which the user opens and confirms: https://day.bemorin.com/#add?task=Buy+bread&day=tomorrow&task=Water+the+plants&repeat=FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=TU,FR (each task= starts a task; note=, sub=, day= and repeat= describe it). Nothing is sent anywhere.
- Tasks from Todoist, TickTick, Google Tasks, Evernote, todo.txt or a table saved as CSV come in through Import backup, read in the browser.
- Full days counts the days, today and before, whose tasks were all ticked. It is not a streak: a missed day takes nothing away.

- [Guide](https://day.bemorin.com/guide/): every feature in plain words, the keyboard shortcuts, installing it, privacy, sync, backups, the lock, and common questions
- [The whole guide in Markdown](https://day.bemorin.com/llms-full.txt): the same guide as one plain Markdown file, to read in full
- [Adding tasks with a link](https://github.com/bemorin/one-day/blob/main/docs/links.md): the link format, every field and repeat, and how to set up Claude and ChatGPT
